item.title: Tuning Tesseract PSM and OEM for Precise OCR Character Recognition
item.description:
“Tuning Tesseract PSM and OEM for Precise OCR Character Recognition”

When employing the pytesseract library for Optical Character Recognition (OCR), achieving highly specific results—such as isolating a single character or recognizing only numeric data—often necessitates fine-tuning Tesseract’s configuration parameters, specifically the Page Segmentation Mode (psm) and the character whitelist. How can these settings be optimally configured, particularly when dealing with different Tesseract versions?

item.title: Solved: How to Fix Pytesseract 'TesseractNotFound Error' - Tesseract Not Installed or Not in Your Path
item.description:
I’m currently encountering an issue while attempting to execute a simple Python script that utilizes Pytesseract for Optical Character Recognition (OCR). Here’s the code snippet I’m working with:

from PIL import Image
import pytesseract

image = Image.open("sample1.jpg")
text_output = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, lang='eng')
print(text_output)

After I installed Tesseract on my Windows machine using the relevant installer, I remained perplexed as it seemed to be functioning correctly. My efforts to remediate the situation included restarting my Spyder IDE, but the error persists.
